info.name: CadPortal API
info.description:
REST API of the internal jewelry CAD vault and product management portal.

**Conventions**
- Everything under `/api/v1` needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (from `POST /auth/login`), except the
  routes marked as public.
- Roles: `admin` (everything), `designer` (edit designs, seats, CAD, costing), `production` (read, job bags,
  CAD downloads; never sees wastage % or stone rates).
- Weights and money are decimals. They are sent and returned as JSON numbers or strings; never rely on float
  rounding. Grams are rounded to 3 dp, carats to 4 dp when stored.
- Errors are `{"error": "message"}`. A 500 also carries `request_id`, which finds the request in the logs.
- A missing stone matrix row is never treated as 0: the API answers 422 and lists the missing (size, code) pairs.
- Every call (except health checks) is written to the audit log; request bodies are never stored.

A selection of variations (a quantity each, each variation on one line only) in one active metal and one stone code. Every line keeps an immutable
snapshot of its weights, stone BOM, CAD file names and hashes and cover photo. Numbers are sequential and
gap-free (`ORD-0001`). No prices are stored. If any variation cannot be ordered (for example missing stone
data) the answer is 422 listing every one, and nothing is saved.

Responses: 201: Created; 400: Invalid input; 422: Variations that cannot be put on the order (every one is listed, nothing is saved)

item.name: Move an order through its status flow (designer, admin)

request.description:
Allowed moves: draft to placed or cancelled; placed to in_production or cancelled; in_production to done or
cancelled. `done` and `cancelled` are final. An order is cancelled, never deleted. Who and when is recorded
in `history`.

Responses: 200: Updated; 400: Invalid input; 404: Not found; 409: Conflict (duplicate code or checksum, state does not allow it)

item.name: Re-order - new order from an old one, with a diff (designer, admin)

request.description:
Every line is re-snapshotted from the current catalog. The source order is untouched. The diff lists, per
line, what changed since the old snapshot. Metal and stone code default to the source order's. Without
`skip_unavailable`, a line whose variation is gone or lacks stone data fails the clone.

Responses: 201: New order and the differences; 404: Not found; 422: Variations that cannot be put on the order (every one is listed, nothing is saved)

item.name: Cost an order and save it as a costing sheet (designer, admin)

request.description:
Costs the order's variations for their quantities in the order's metal and stone code from the **current**
masters and designs (not the snapshot), and saves an immutable costing sheet linked to the order.
Missing data fails the run with the grouped list (422) unless `skip_incomplete`. `drift` shows how far the
live designs have moved from the order's snapshots.

Responses: 201: Saved sheet and drift; 400: Invalid input; 404: Not found; 422: Costing data is incomplete (no wastage %, no stone rate, or no matrix row)

item.name: Stream one ZIP of CAD files for a selection (any role)

request.description:
Streams a ZIP of the original STL / 3dm files of the chosen variations, or of all live variations of the
chosen designs, followed by `MANIFEST.csv` (ok / missing / hash-mismatch / error per file). Nothing is
held in memory and hashes are verified on the fly. For scripts: a browser should use `/link` instead,
because a plain navigation cannot send the bearer token.

Limits: 413 over `CAD_ZIP_MAX_FILES` (default 1000) or `CAD_ZIP_MAX_MB` (default 5 GB); 429 with
`Retry-After` while the same user already has a ZIP running. Audited as `download.cad_zip`.

Responses: 200: ZIP stream; 400: Invalid input; 413: Request or file too large; 429: The same user already has a ZIP running; 503: File storage is not configured

request.description:

Responses: 200: Plan and link; 400: Invalid input; 413: Request or file too large; 503: File storage is not configured

item.name: Open a signed CAD ZIP link (no bearer token)

request.description:
The `url` returned by `/downloads/cad-zip/link`. Authenticated by the signed ticket, valid for two minutes,
and refused if the person it was made for was deactivated or changed their password since. The plan is
made again from live data, so a file replaced in the meantime is the current one.

Responses: 200: ZIP stream; 403: The role may not do this; 429: The same user already has a ZIP running

Two shapes. **Items**: `items[]` with `gold_rate_per_g` and `setting_rate_per_pc` (one row per item).
**Selection**: `design_ids` and/or `variation_ids` (max 500) with a single `metal_code`/`stone_code`:
one row per variation plus a total row; all-or-nothing unless `skip_incomplete`.
The last column `stone_pricing` says how each stone line was priced.
`X-Costing-Incomplete` holds the number of variations not costed.

Responses: 200: CSV; 400: Invalid input; 422: Costing data is incomplete (no wastage %, no stone rate, or no matrix row)
